info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Rideshare Rides Routes-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Routes Listing API allows users to retrieve a list of available rideshare routes. This API provides crucial information for customers looking to plan their trips efficiently by viewing all the route options offered. Typical consumers include mobile app developers and ride-hailing service providers who need to display accessible routes in their applications. The operation supports enhanced user experience by enabling dynamic route selection based on the availability of rides.

get.summary: Retrieve the optimal route for a ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the optimal route for a ride based on the given parameters. It calculates the best path considering factors such as distance, traffic, and route efficiency to provide users with an accurate and reliable navigation experience.

ListRideshareRidesRoutesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the 'GET' operation on the rides route. It expects a string value, typically a JSON-encoded string representing the route request.
